About me

Teacher · Producer · Musician
ESL TeacherMusic Technology

I build lessons the way I build tracks: structure first, then the details that make it feel alive.

I am an ESL teacher with two years of classroom experience in Shenzhen, teaching Grades 1 to 3 in classes of 35 to 50. I design the lessons, materials and assessments, and I build individual support plans for students of different abilities. I am completing a PGCE (expected June 2027) on top of a 120-hour TEFL certificate and IELTS and TOEIC preparation training. A degree in Sound Engineering and Technology, guitar and ukulele teaching, studio production and a working knowledge of AI in music shape how I make lessons creative and engaging. I have lived and worked in South Africa, the UK and China, which helps me build rapport with students, parents and colleagues.
